name: Agent Bazaar by Saylor Innovations
description: Open discovery catalog for x402-payable APIs, MCP tools, datasets, and agent services. Agent Bazaar does not sit in the payment path; clients pay providers directly.
capabilities: Search x402-payable resources by keyword, provider, network, asset, payment recipient, URL substring, and max USD price.
List paginated resource records using Coinbase Bazaar-compatible items and pagination aliases.
Return filter facets so agents can plan discovery by network, asset, scheme, provider, type, price band, liveness, and trust state.
Expose machine-readable resource twins, A2A agent records, OpenAPI, llms.txt, and guide JSON for crawler-friendly inspection.

search.description: Search the x402 resource catalog by keyword, network, asset, payment recipient, URL substring, scheme, or maximum USD price.

parameters.query: Optional free-text search over URL, description, type, tags, provider, and metadata.
parameters.network: Optional CAIP-2 network filter, such as eip155:8453 or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp.
parameters.scheme: Optional x402 payment scheme, usually exact.
parameters.payTo: Optional receiving wallet or merchant address.
parameters.maxUsdPrice: Optional maximum payable price in USD.

search.useWhen: Use when an agent has intent or constraints and needs the best matching x402 resources.

resources.description: Paginated x402 discovery resource listing, ranked by call volume or recency.
resources.useWhen: Use when crawling or synchronizing the catalog page by page.

facets.description: Compact discovery facets for networks, assets, schemes, resource types, providers, price bands, liveness, and trust states.

parameters.limit: Optional maximum values per ranked facet list, default 25, max 100.

facets.useWhen: Use before search when an agent needs to understand available filters or decide which network/provider/asset slices to crawl.

merchant.description: Find all resources payable to a specific receiving wallet or merchant address.

parameters.payTo: Required receiving wallet or merchant address.

merchant.useWhen: Use when grouping endpoints by provider wallet or verifying which resources share a payment recipient.

stats.description: Catalog totals for listings, resources, accepts, merchants, networks, and 30-day call volume. full=1 adds network/source breakdowns.

parameters.full: Optional 1 for per-network and per-source breakdowns.

stats.useWhen: Use for quick connectivity checks, catalog sizing, and high-level health checks.

featured.description: Currently featured resources in the catalog.

parameters.limit: Optional number of featured resources to return.

featured.useWhen: Use when an agent wants a short starter set of promoted or highlighted x402 resources.

agents.description: Search or list registered A2A agents and their machine-readable agent cards.

parameters.query: Optional free-text search over agent name, provider, description, skills, and card URL.

agents.useWhen: Use when finding other agents rather than payable x402 resources.

resourceRecord.description: Full machine-readable record for one resource, including accepts, schema, tags, metadata, liveness, and verification state.

parameters.slug: Required resource slug from discovery results.

resourceRecord.useWhen: Use after search/list to inspect payment options, schema, and agent-facing metadata before attempting a paid call.

guides.description: Machine-readable guide index for x402, MCP, A2A, publishing, and agent discovery documentation.
guides.useWhen: Use when an agent needs implementation guidance or explanatory context.

guideRecord.description: Plain-text machine twin of a guide.
guideRecord.useWhen: Use when an agent needs the full text of a specific guide without parsing HTML.

openapi.description: OpenAPI 3.1 schema for Agent Bazaar discovery, submission, resource, agent, and guide endpoints.
openapi.useWhen: Use when generating client tools or validating request/response shapes.

mcp.description: MCP interface over the same discovery catalog.
mcp.useWhen: Use when an MCP-native client wants tool calls instead of direct REST requests.
